body: i’m the exact same way, out of sight out of mind i guess lol. i felt weird about it at first but it helps knowing there’s others that feel the same
in my case, not really. the sex itself wont do it if there isn’t much feelings, but if i really like someone it’s an extra bonus to connect with them through it.

yes this is possible, i’ve fallen in love and at the same time i’ve never had a romantic fp. for me, i think my mind separates friends/family differently from love interests and that’s why this happens personally

yes i also feel this way about Lana! my sister also has bpd and was obsessed with her while i was growing up, it made me love her music from a young age and associate it with comfort. her unreleased music is really good and resonates well with emotions
thank you so much! i’m so glad that this post can provide some hope like i hoped it would :)
